subject: Intramural volleyball registration is open
body:
Hi Northfield students,

Winter intramural volleyball registration is now open! Teams of 6–10 play Tuesday and Thursday evenings at the Riverside Gym starting January 13. Register your team on the Experience Northfield Portal by December 5. Free agents welcome.

Go Northfield!
Northfield Athletics

subject: Action required: confirm your winter student aid enrolment
body:
Dear Student,

To release your winter student aid, you must confirm your enrolment in the Student Portal by November 28. If you do not confirm, your funding may be delayed until February.

Student Financial Services
Northfield University
